theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_rc_cone_exclusion
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (K : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (δ ε : ℝ), (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → 0 ≤ ε → (1 + 16 ^ m) * ε < 1 → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) * unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ m) ≤ μ (closedBall x ρ)) → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ ({z | (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - x) (ν x)|} ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ m)) → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ x' ∈ K, ∀ v : Euclid (m + 1), ‖ν x - v‖ ≤ 1 / 16 → ‖x' - x‖ < δ / 2 → |inner ℝ (x' - x) v| ≤ ‖x' - x‖ / 2
